summary_brief: 今日（10-07）延续9月下旬以来"Agent安全治理+基础设施成熟"主线，但重心出现向"多智能体编排生产级管控"与"能力原语标准化"迁移的新推进点，无方向性转折。延续层面：①Agent沙箱逃逸防护与供应链完整性（codex连续修复可写工作区预隔离、bubblewrap逃逸、Windows沙箱对齐；turborepo引入SHA-512强制校验；gemini-cli强制不可信目录只读）直接回应10-01~10-06安全与信任边界主线；②MCP生态稳定性与多租户隔离继续加固（cline超时放宽、deer-flow按所有权域隔离池化会话、codex BM25工具发现），延续10-03/06的工具检索与互操作主线；③LLM评测向延迟/追踪级维度扩展（Phoenix TRAIL八任务、promptfoo声明式断言），延续9月以来评测方法论深化。真正的新增推进点在于两点：其一，多智能体编排从"能跑"迈向"可观测、可追溯、可管控"的生产级阶段——codex以parentTurnId/rootTurnId持久化回合血统、ruflo发布Workflows控制平面、claude-agent-sdk为子代理消息添加agent_id/parent_task_id/run_id，跨项目不约而同解决多代理委派的追溯、归因与交互控制（impact 5），这是从10-06"安全威胁建模"向"编排治理"的递进；其二，平台级能力原语标准化——OpenAI官方SDK推出独立Decisions API且被vercel/ai用原生API替代prompt包装、推理模型识别与跨供应商可移植max reasoning level标准（GPT-6/Grok识别）浮出水面，标志决策与推理正脱离通用对话链路成为一等公民。构建工具链（Turborepo/Next.js）系统性融入Agent技能与安全预置亦为基建成熟佐证。整体定性：从安全的"堵漏"进阶到编排的"可治理"与能力的"标准化"，生产级成熟阶段继续深化。

engineering_signals.title: 多智能体编排走向生产级：回合谱系可追溯性与控制平面成为标配
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: codex 通过 parentTurnId/rootTurnId 持久化回合血统、ruflo 发布 Workflows 控制平面与任务自动驾驶、claude-agent-sdk 为子代理消息添加 agent_id/parent_task_id/run_id，多个独立项目不约而同地解决多代理委派的可追溯性、归因与交互控制问题，标志多智能体系统从实验阶段跨入需要监管审计与生产运维的成熟阶段。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 沙箱安全与供应链完整性成为跨厂商核心攻防阵地
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: codex 连续修复 PATH 中可写工作区预隔离执行、bubblewrap 逃逸与 Windows 沙箱临时目录对齐；turborepo 引入 SHA-512 强制校验与有界 npm 元数据解析；gemini-cli 强制不可信目录只读、codex 加固 rg 解析防止命令注入，各项目密集投入 agent 代码执行环境的隔离边界与依赖供应链完整性，反映 AI agent 安全从"事后修补"转向"预置防线"的系统化建设。

engineering_signals.title: 原生决策能力标准化：OpenAI Decisions API 被生态快速采纳
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI 在官方 Python SDK 推出独立 Decisions API（支持同步/异步客户端及结构化谓词/选择/分数），vercel/ai 随即用原生 Decisions API 替代 prompt 包装实现 decide 能力，这一能力从"模型提示技巧"升级为"平台级结构化原语"，标志决策类任务正在脱离通用对话链路。

engineering_signals.title: 推理模型识别与可移植推理等级标准浮出水面
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: agno 修复 GPT-5/6 推理模型识别与路由、vercel/ai 引入跨供应商可移植的 max reasoning level 并拓宽 ReasoningLevel 类型、promptfoo 新增 GPT-6 Sol/Luna 与 Grok 4.7 等新模型支持，多厂商协同建立推理模型的统一识别与等级标准化，反映推理（reasoning）正成为跨模型调用清单中的一等公民能力。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 生态稳定性与多租户隔离持续加固
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: cline 将 MCP 初始化超时从 384s 放宽到 946s 修复 Windows 启动慢问题、deer-flow 按所有权域隔离池化 MCP stdio 会话防止串扰、codex 引入 BM25 排名工具发现以改善大型 MCP 工具集选择质量，MCP 已成为 agent 工具互操作核心，围绕其稳定性、隔离与可发现性的工程投入持续上升。

engineering_signals.title: 局部流式响应与增量输出成为多智能体协议演进方向
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: codex 引入独立 partial_answer 消息阶段使流式助手输出在未终结前即可被表示与路由、并统一到各 agent 工作流，为实时语音/TUI 增量响应与多 agent 协作的消息模型奠定协议基础，这一抽象演进对实时交互型 agent 应用意义深远。

engineering_signals.title: 构建工具链融入 AI 能力：Turborepo/Next.js 引入 Agent 技能与安全预置
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Next.js 的 next upgrade 从硬编码模型列表转向运行时并行探测各代理 CLI 可用模型、新增 Bundle Analyzer Agent Skill 让 AI 自动分析 bundle 加载路径、Turborepo 推出独立 setup 命令体系并加固供应链校验，主流构建工具链正系统性融入 AI agent 能力与安全预置，成为工程基础设施的一部分。

research_signals.title: LLM 评测基准向延迟与追踪级标注维度扩展
research_signals.why_it_matters: Arize-ai/phoenix 为 TRAIL benchmark 新增八个评测任务，覆盖延迟分位数与追踪级标注并可靠播种标注，而 promptfoo 连续修复异步/关键字属性等声明式断言场景，显示 LLM 评测正从纯准确率转向包含延迟、可观测性与复杂代码结构的复合评测能力。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 插件市场与子代理增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增插件市场安装、子代理effort参数控制及工作流代理支持，显著扩展了Claude Code的自动化编排能力和生态扩展性。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 安全加固与沙箱修复
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了PreToolUse钩子绕过权限提示、沙箱读取拒绝路径、符号链接文件读取等多个安全漏洞，增强了企业级使用的安全性。

release_signals.title: Agent SDK 子代理追踪能力增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: 为子代理消息添加agent_id、parent_task_id和run_id，使开发者能更精确地追踪和管理复杂的多代理任务执行流程。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Python SDK 新增决策支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增独立的Decisions API支持，并增强代理工具（本地工具失败观察、流式会话中运行本地工具），扩展了OpenAI SDK的代理能力边界。

release_signals.title: OpenHands 模型路由与画布应用升级
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增Model Router直接提示设置、批量添加LLM配置文件和画布应用更新功能，大幅提升了多模型管理和自动化工作流的灵活性。

release_signals.title: Semantic Kernel 多语言同步更新
release_signals.why_it_matters: .NET和Python版本同步更新，改进Milvus过滤、文件处理及OpenAPI插件验证，并统一了HTTP请求验证工具，增强了跨语言一致性。

release_signals.title: Gemini CLI 非交互模式自主规划执行
release_signals.why_it_matters: 在非交互模式下启用自主规划执行，并优化长运行代理循环的内存管理和工具输出大小限制，提升了自动化场景的实用性。

release_signals.title: Promptfoo 模型支持与依赖精简
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Sol/Luna、Grok 4.7等最新模型支持，同时将多个SDK改为可选安装，大幅精简了核心依赖体积。

release_signals.title: DeepAgents 插件发现与追踪控制
release_signals.why_it_matters: 代理可自动发现市场插件，新增--no-tracing选项和成本明细查看功能，增强了代理的自主性和可观测性。

release_signals.title: Vercel SDK 连接器托管弹出功能
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增supportsManagedEjection和ejectManagedConnector API，为托管连接器提供更灵活的弹出管理能力，影响Vercel集成生态。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai 批量发版 80 个子包（4 个值得注意）
release_signals.why_it_matters: vercel/ai 本次批量发版 80 个子包虽均为 patch 版本（仓库对 feature 也走 patch 策略），但并非纯版本同步，而是包含广泛的实质变更：核心是跨 20+ provider 新增可移植的 max 推理级别，@ai-sdk/openai 将 decide 切换为原生 OpenAI Decisions API（仅 gpt-6-luna 受支持），@ai-sdk/google 新增新模型 ID，并伴随全局 TypeScript 6 升级与多项修复。无官方标记的 major/breaking，但 openai 的 model 支持收窄与 max 级别的类型拓宽对部分消费者存在兼容性风险，整体综合影响为中等（级别 3）。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/provider@4.0.23
release_signals.why_it_matters: 底层规格新增可移植 max 推理级别，虽为 patch 但拓宽了 ReasoningLevel 类型，对 exhaustive switch 消费者存在披露的源码兼容性提醒。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/openai@4.0.850
release_signals.why_it_matters: 将 decide 替换为原生 Decisions API，仅 gpt-6-luna 受支持，其它 Responses 模型的 decisionModel()/evaluationModel() 行为被移除禁用。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/google@4.0.89
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 gemini-nano-banana-2.1 模型 ID，并保留检索上下文的 file search 自定义元数据，属新能力。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai ai@7.0.129
release_signals.why_it_matters: 核心包包含稳定代码 deprecation 警告、V2 token 保留、stream resume 等多项修复及 TS6 升级，影响面最大。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `--marketplace <source>` to `claude plugin install`: adds the marketplace if needed, under the same policy checks as `claude plugin marketplace add`, then installs the plugin from it
- Added an `effort` parameter to the Agent tool, so Claude runs a sub-agent at the effort level you ask for
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer base delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request
- Added `prompt.autocomplete`, an event a mod hooks to add its own rows to the prompt box's autocomplete list
- Added prompt caching to `$.model.complete` for mods: `prompt` and `system` take blocks of text, and `cache: true` on a block caches the request up to it
- Added workflow agents to the `agent.spawn` mod hook, with their run and index, so a mod can refuse them
- Fixed subagent definitions with `permissionMode: auto` entering auto mode when auto mode is unavailable (disabled by settings, circuit breaker, or a model that doesn't support it)
- Fixed sandboxed commands being able to read the staged file copies of `/ultrareview` uploads under `~/.claude/seed-admin`
- Fixed a managed sandbox read-deny path (and user ones beside it) that appears or re-points mid-session not dropping project grants inside it or ending credential injection from files it covers
- Fixed a notebook or PDF read on macOS and Windows being able to return a file outside what was approved, through a link swapped in mid-read
- Fixed a tampered on-disk cache of server-managed settings being able to switch off or unseat the built-in policy plugin while the settings fetch failed
- Fixed `rm -rf` on the 8.3 short name or another alternate Windows spelling of the home folder or a drive not being treated as removing it
- Security: Fixed PreToolUse hook approvals and auto mode bypassing the permission prompt for file reads from network (UNC) paths
- Fixed a skill's or slash command's `allowed-tools` rule coming back in a later turn when you leave auto mode or plan mode partway through that turn
- Fixed `NO_PROXY` being ignored for Claude Code's own API requests (sign-in, policy, feedback, artifacts) when `HTTPS_PROXY` is set
- Fixed an MCP tool with a name longer than 128 characters making every request fail; that tool is now left out and an MCP error names it
- Fixed `claude plugin` commands such as `marketplace add` and `install` running before an organization's managed settings had loaded on a first run
- Fixed one-shot `claude -p` and Agent SDK runs stopping a background command 5 seconds after the final result, and one-shot `claude -p` runs dropping a scheduled wakeup; both are now waited for
- Fixed plan mode not being restored when resuming a session from the `claude --resume` session picker or with `/resume`
- Fixed saved scheduled tasks created after `/resume`, `/branch` or `/clear` never firing, and saved tasks ignoring later creates and deletes after two writes to the tasks file milliseconds apart
- Fixed a background session's `/loop` silently stopping when the session's process restarted (for example after a crash), because its pending wakeup was lost
- Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the file or folder they were given could not be read; Claude now retries once or tells you
- Fixed the Read tool returning only the first entry, with no error, when a PDF's `pages` was a list such as "6,9,15"; it now returns an error saying to read each page or range separately
- Fixed @-mentioned text files over 256KB being left out silently: Claude is now told the file's size and to read it in portions
- Fixed the usage limit alert repeating once per background agent when agents failed on a limit that had already stopped the main conversation
- Fixed Remote Control viewers seeing an empty subagent pane for background subagents in sessions hosted by the desktop app or an IDE
- Fixed cross-session delivery notices showing two sessions with similar names as one recipient, and the expiry notice blaming the desktop app when a terminal session let the message lapse
- Fixed Send now in the desktop app ending the subagent a turn was waiting on when another message was already queued
- Fixed `/bug`, `/share` and `/feedback <text>` starting over after Ctrl+O or Ctrl+Z while a report was being sent, and closing as cancelled after it had been sent
- Fixed `/remote-env` replacing your saved default environment when you pressed Enter right away: the list now opens on your default, and no row has a check mark when no default is in effect
- Fixed some pasted text reaching Claude as typed text when several pastes overlapped in one prompt
- Fixed vim mode leaving the cursor past the end of a line, j/k losing their column on shorter lines, and `f`/`t`/`F`/`T`/`;`/`,` jumping to, or deleting up to, a match on another line of the prompt
- Fixed `/add-dir` path box letting Shift+Enter or a paste add a line break, and treating fast-typed "tab", "up" or "down" as those keys
- Fixed fast typing, input-method text and decomposed accents being dropped while a prompt footer row was selected, and `!` leaving the row selected
- Fixed fullscreen mode sending a full-screen clear on every window resize and Ctrl+L when iTerm2 is detected, which may be what filled iTerm2's scrollback with stale pages
- Fixed a spurious "could not be examined" note for @-words that name no file when a Read deny rule is set and the working directory is under a symlink
- Fixed "instruction file not loaded" lines going stale or missing after `/cd` or a permission change, and added a transcript line when a nested one isn't loaded
- Fixed a compaction summary that repeated `/name` letting Claude invoke a skill that is reserved for the user
- Fixed Write, Edit, NotebookEdit and LSP rows, and single Read, Grep and Glob rows, hiding why a mod denied the call: the row now shows the reason
- Fixed a cloud session showing a turn that never ended when its worker was stopped just as the turn finished
- Fixed cloud sessions with a large transcript sometimes asking for a permission again after it was approved
- Fixed scheduled tasks and other queued notifications being lost in cloud sessions when a message was retried or edited while Claude was reading them
- Fixed cloud sessions forgetting the thinking setting chosen in the client when the session's container restarted
- Fixed Cowork cloud sessions saying a proxy blocked artifacts when Anthropic couldn't confirm the organization's settings
- Fixed plugins whose hooks module makes many `$.state` calls through one const taking minutes to load or validate
- Fixed `claude plugin validate` listing a matcher or state value for a hooks module that the engine reads from elsewhere
- Fixed `claude plugin validate` listing a `$.state` value read through a top-level `var` that was declared again or reassigned; such a module is now refused
- Fixed a plugin's served `$` method restarting the hook origin, which could run a guard hook with a `.catch` above it again without end
- Fixed plugin interface calls made while the plugin hooks worker restarts running without the hooks other plugins put on them
- Fixed a mod's `config.set`, `state.set`, `env.set` or `agent.spawn` hook that denies after calling `next(e)` being answered as a refusal: the hook is now reported as failed, by name
- Fixed `/theme`, the `/config` Theme menu and the first-run theme step saving a theme before a plugin's `config.set` hook was asked
- Fixed a plugin's `tool.check` hook answering allow running a tool that requires your answer (a question, a plan approval) without showing its dialog
- Fixed a mod's start-up prompt, command or subagent being queued a second time when the hooks worker was replaced
- Fixed a mod's hook that called `next(e)` and then failed while the turn was interrupted letting the call through; the call is now rejected
- Fixed a plugin's prompt drop or setting deny being ignored when its reason was longer than 4,096 characters
- Fixed an organization's plugin being unloaded on its own reload, or after another plugin crashed, when it returned a `$` name that a user-installed mod had added; the mod is now unloaded instead
- Fixed tool calls made while the plugin hooks worker restarts being answered without the plugins' permission hooks
- Fixed plugin `tool.call` hooks seeing some tool calls before misnamed parameters were repaired; a hook now sees the arguments the tool will run with
- Fixed a mod's guard hook with a `.catch` being skipped silently for calls another mod's hook makes beneath the guard's own `$` call; its `.catch` is now asked
- Improved startup of `claude -p` and SDK sessions: the first turn no longer waits for HTTP and SSE MCP servers to answer `resources/list`
- Improved rendering speed of long bulleted or numbered replies: they stream, resize and re-open in the transcript (ctrl+o) much faster
- Improved Ctrl+C draft recovery: a cleared prompt now stays reachable with Up after a slash command or a sent message
- Improved hook output handling: `<system-reminder>` tags written in a hook's output are escaped before they reach Claude
- Improved tool input handling: Grep accepts `file_path` for `path`, and Write, WebFetch and Read ignore a few stray parameters instead of failing the call
- Improved the steps shown when a marketplace declared in a settings file has a name that looks like an official Anthropic marketplace
- Improved sandbox auto-allow: with strict sandbox mode set in user, managed or --settings settings, an interpreter command with an env var prefix like `FOO=bar python3 app.py` runs unprompted
- Improved the Artifact tool's listing: Claude now sees how many published artifacts you have and can list up to 200 at once instead of 50
- Improved cloud sessions after a restart: Claude is now told which stopped background agents it can resume by id
- Improved the Claude in Chrome message in claude.ai cloud sessions when the browser can't be reached: Claude is now told it may continue with alternatives if the user prefers
- Improved the /focus tip: it now invites you to try focus view mid-turn and shows how to switch back
- Improved startup with local (stdio) MCP servers that ignore the newer protocol check: after one slow connect they are remembered for 7 days and connected the older way without the wait
- Changed local (stdio) MCP server connections to negotiate protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on every install, including Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry; `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out
- Changed `claude plugin test`: a failed `expect` inside a hook the test registered, or a stub answer the engine refuses, now fails the test instead of passing silently
- Changed usage limit messages to write claude.ai settings links with https:// so terminals and apps can make them clickable
- Changed scheduled and Run now routine runs to publish a new artifact only you can see without asking for approval; artifacts that request connectors or other access still ask
- Changed agent names to allow at most 256 characters: a longer one is rejected, and a skill's or a plugin file's `name` longer than that is ignored
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs occasionally staying listed as running for hours after they had finished
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed editing or duplicating a routine turning off its push notifications when the routine had no saved notification setting
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed SVG, HEIC, TIFF and other less common image files failing to attach; they now attach as regular files
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed approval prompts offering "Always allow" for connector tools that an organization set to require approval; the choice had no effect
- [Remote Control] Fixed the first message of a new Remote Control session started from claude.ai/code accepting only images; it now accepts PDFs and other files like later messages
- [Claude Tag] Added an Edit button to the Allowed domains card on a channel's Configure page, so Enterprise admins can open the access bundle that sets the channel's domains
- [Claude Tag] Fixed replies sent in a Slack thread while Claude was still on its first request there being held until that request finished, or missed when sent seconds apart
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Slack threads woken only by GitHub pull request activity or a routine staying on their original model after an admin changed the channel or workspace default model
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude sometimes posting a spend limit notice in Slack when the real cause was that your organization had run out of usage credits
- [Claude Tag] Fixed a session hanging until interrupted when a permission prompt that can't be answered from Slack was denied automatically
- [Claude Tag] Improved `@Claude !status` in a channel to say when Claude has stopped reading its untagged messages, why, and that an @-mention starts it reading again
- [Claude Tag] Changed the first message of a Slack thread continued with `!fork` to a card showing where it came from, the request, and who asked, with a link to the original thread
- [Claude Tag] Changed the organization-wide and default spend limit boxes on Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings to save only when you press Save or Enter, not when you click away
- [Code Review] Added the period's total with its change from the previous period, and a breakdown by repository, to the PRs reviewed chart in Code Review analytics
- [Code Review] Fixed a queued review failing when the pull request moved to a new base branch and the old one was deleted; the commit is now re-queued for review
- [Code Review] Fixed reviews ignoring a CLAUDE.md's rules when the pull request edits that file; reviews now use its version from the base branch

key_changes: 新增 `--marketplace` 参数支持从指定源安装插件，并受相同策略检查约束
新增 `effort` 参数到 Agent 工具，可指定子代理的执行力度级别；新增 `prompt.autocomplete` 事件和 Mod 的 `$.model.complete` 提示缓存功能
大量修复：包括安全漏洞修复（PreToolUse 钩子绕过权限、UNC 路径文件读取）、MCP 工具超长名称导致请求失败、沙箱命令读取 staged 文件副本、`NO_PROXY` 被忽略等问题
改进启动性能：`claude -p` 和 SDK 会话不再等待 MCP 服务器响应 `resources/list`，长文本渲染速度提升

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `agent_id` to the `assistant` and `user` messages a subagent produces; it equals the `task_id` on that subagent's task events and stays the same when the subagent is resumed
- Added `parent_task_id` to `task_started` events and `background_tasks_changed` entries, naming the subagent task that launched a task
- Added `run_id` to background task events and `origin.runId` to task notifications, so a host can tell a resumed task's runs apart
- Added typed `sections` and `notes` to the `ListAgents` tool's `tool_use_result`, so hosts can list agents without parsing its text
- Added `recipient_kind` to SendMessage `tool_use` inputs on assistant messages, and their top-level `approve` is now always a boolean, so hosts no longer infer them from the raw input
- Added two optional fields to the `ReadNotifications` tool output: `read_at`, when the tool read the session's queued notifications, and `arrived_at` on each notification, when it reached the session
- Fixed subagents with a declared auto permission mode having their tool calls decided by the auto-mode classifier instead of the canUseTool callback when auto mode is unavailable
- Changed `background_tasks_changed` for a finishing background task to arrive after that task's `task_updated` and `task_notification`
- Changed `canUseTool` options to carry `suppressAlwaysAllowRule: true` for connector tools that an organization set to require approval, so hosts can hide their "always allow" choice
- Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.292

## Update

```sh
npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.292
# or
yarn add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.292
# or
pnpm add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.292
# or
bun add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.292
```

key_changes: 为子代理的 assistant 和 user 消息新增 agent_id 字段（等于其 task_id，恢复后保持不变），并新增 task_started 事件和 background_tasks_changed 条目的 parent_task_id 字段，用于标识发起任务的子代理任务
为后台任务事件新增 run_id，任务通知新增 origin.runId，便于主机区分恢复任务的不同运行实例；为 ListAgents 工具的 tool_use_result 新增类型化的 sections 和 notes 字段
优化 SendMessage 工具输入（新增 recipient_kind）和 ReadNotifications 工具输出（新增 read_at 和 arrived_at 字段），并统一 approve 字段为布尔类型
修复子代理在声明自动权限模式时，工具调用错误地由自动模式分类器而非 canUseTool 回调决策的问题；调整 background_tasks_changed 事件的触发时序
为 canUseTool 选项新增 suppressAlwaysAllowRule 支持，使主机可隐藏组织要求审批的连接器工具的『始终允许』选项；同步更新至 Claude Code v2.1.292
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次更新主要新增了多项面向主机集成的结构化数据字段，包括子代理的 agent_id、任务链的 parent_task_id、后台任务的 run_id，以及 ListAgents/SendMessage/ReadNotifications 等工具的类型化输出字段，大幅增强了主机侧可编程性，减少了对原始文本或输入推断的依赖。同时修复了自动权限模式下子代理工具调用的决策逻辑问题，并调整了后台任务事件的触发时序。整体为功能增强型更新，不涉及破坏性变更，建议依赖任务追踪或工具链集成的主机用户升级。

releases.summary:
## ruflo 3.53.0

The npm packages (`@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo`) are a version bump plus a catalog entry. The big changes live in the console, ruflo-protector and mods plugins, which reach you through the git marketplace, not npm.

### What is new: ruflo-console 0.34.0

- **Intelligence views**: a memory map (a hash layout, labelled as such, not a similarity map), a learning pipeline and router picture, explain-a-recall with a pattern lifecycle, and memory health.
- **Workflows board**: phases, agents, model, tokens and time per run, with drill-down, search and logs, replay, compare, export, cost and a budget guard, triage, alerts, a worktree manager, templates, and Anatole per agent.
- **Control plane and multi-model bridge**: Stop, Message and Redirect through TaskStop and SendMessage, proven for Agent-tool background agents and **unverified for a workflow run's own agents**. A Conversation pane covers Claude, the hive, federation, Codex, and OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- **Mission autopilot**: one approved scope envelope, a journal, a kill switch, parking, and governed self-tuning that cannot widen its own envelope. **It has not yet run in a live interactive session**, and long runs need the session to stay alive.
- Three adversarial audits were run on the above.

### How to get it

npm: `npx ruflo@latest`. For the console, ruflo-protector and mods:

```
claude plugin marketplace update ruflo
claude plugin update ruflo-console@ruflo
```

then restart Claude Code.

### Known limits

- About 190 ms extra plugin load per start (the engine transpiles the whole module graph). All 216 kit tests pass file by file, but 3 to 8 time out when all 25 files run at once under heavy load.
- npm Audit checks are red on main from newly published advisories in dependencies (proxy-addr, tinypool, and one more transitive). Being fixed separately.
- SendMessage delivery and agent control inside a workflow run are unverified.

新增工作流面板：支持阶段/代理/模型/令牌/耗时展示，含下钻、搜索、日志、重放、对比、导出、成本预算、告警、工作树管理、模板及按代理的 Anatole 功能
新增控制平面与多模型桥接：支持 Stop/Message/Redirect 操作，覆盖 Claude、Hive、联邦、Codex、OpenRouter 及 OpenAI 兼容端点
新增 Mission 自动驾驶功能：统一批准范围、日志、终止开关、停放及受限自调优机制
已知限制：SendMessage 投递和工作流内代理控制在非验证状态，插件加载增加约 190ms 开销

key_changes: Agent 现在可自动发现并加载市场插件（Marketplace plugins）
新增 --no-tracing 命令行选项及显式的 tracing 状态指示器
优化了交互体验：运行中可打开 effort 选择器、从页脚查看成本明细、多行聊天输入高亮当前行
将 /summarization-model 命令重命名为 /offload model
多个稳定性修复：修复 Bedrock 非 Anthropic 模型的兼容性、防止本地线程并发写入、恢复运行时的 hook 上下文校验等
ai_summary.summary_cn: deepagents-code 0.1.81 版本主要引入多项新功能，包括 Agent 支持自动发现市场插件、新增 --no-tracing 选项及 tracing 状态指示、优化运行中的 effort 选择和成本查看交互。同时修复了多个问题，涵盖 Bedrock 模型兼容性、本地线程并发写入、hook 上下文变更、模型目录管理与缓存过期等问题，并进行了命令重命名和多项 UI 优化。

## Core

### Improvements
- Added canonical redirects and JSON and Markdown data formats for agent-readable stats.

### Bugfixes
- xAI tool results now include supported images, while unsupported image formats are skipped. (@Jaaneek)

**Thank you to 3 community contributors:**
- @dc85:
  - docs(web): add Fledge Alpha Free to Zen docs (#52895)
- @jm0ney337:
  - docs(ecosystem): add opencode-supabase to ecosystem plugins (#49848)
- @Jaaneek:
  - fix(opencode): bump @ai-sdk/xai to 3.0.139 so tool-result images reach xAI (#53549)

key_changes: 新增规范重定向（canonical redirects），支持面向代理可读统计数据的 JSON 和 Markdown 数据格式
修复 xAI 工具结果对图片格式的支持，支持的图片格式可以正常传递，不支持的格式会被跳过
升级 @ai-sdk/xai 至 3.0.139 以修复工具结果图片传递问题
文档更新：为 Zen 文档添加 Fledge Alpha Free，为生态系统插件列表添加 opencode-supabase
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本主要带来两个方向的改进：一是为代理可读统计数据新增规范重定向以及 JSON 和 Markdown 数据格式支持，提升数据可访问性；二是修复了 xAI 工具结果中图片格式的处理问题，支持图片格式会被正常传递，不支持的格式将被跳过。此外还包含文档更新和 3 个社区贡献者的贡献。

releases.summary:
### Patch Changes

- e37d213: feat(ai): emit deprecation warnings with stable codes and deduplicate them
- 73d8343: fix(ai): preserve V2 provider-reported total tokens in raw usage
- 268225c: feat(provider): add a portable `max` reasoning level with native provider mappings, compatibility coercions, and budget-based fallback support.

  Compatibility notes:

  - **TypeScript source compatibility:** Adding `max` widens `LanguageModelV4CallOptions['reasoning']` and the derived `ReasoningLevel` type. Third-party providers and consumers with exhaustive switches or `Record<ReasoningLevel, ...>` mappings must handle `max` before upgrading. Ordinary calls using existing reasoning levels remain accepted.
  - **Amazon Bedrock:** Existing Nova 2 calls using portable `reasoning: 'xhigh'` now send `maxReasoningEffort: 'high'` instead of the unsupported `'max'`, and return a compatibility warning. Anthropic and OpenAI Bedrock effort mappings retain their existing `xhigh` behavior. Partial Bedrock reasoning configurations continue to preserve explicit values and derive missing fields; explicit effort/budget overrides and disabled thinking no longer emit warnings for portable mappings that are not sent.
  - **Fireworks:** Existing portable `minimal` and `xhigh` calls keep their request mappings to `low` and `high`, respectively, and now return compatibility warnings in generation and streaming results. Portable `max` maps to `high` with the same warning behavior.

  **Release classification:** This remains a patch changeset under the repository's explicit release policy, which uses patch releases for both fixes and features. The TypeScript source-compatibility caveat for exhaustive consumers is disclosed above. Maintainers can override this classification with a `major` label if they decide to align the provider-spec addition with a future AI SDK major release.

- d83366e: fix(ai): publish the latest error after repeated failed stream resume attempts
- 34905a2: fix(ai): preserve provider options from approval-only tool messages
- 16ab882: fix(ai): recognize WebKit network errors
- f810ea3: fix(ai): prevent unavailable tools from exposing persisted output to models
- 19a127b: fix(ai): avoid duplicate slashes in chat reconnect URLs
- 0af2f7c: chore: upgrade to TypeScript 6
- 4c6979c: fix(harness): preserve adapter warnings in agent stream results and declare
  their compatibility warning shapes

key_changes: 全部 80 个子包均为 patch 版本（仓库发版策略对 fix 与 feature 均用 patch），但并非纯版本同步，而是一次集中式实质更新。

核心变更：在 provider 规格中新增可移植的 max 推理级别（changeset 268225c），贯穿 @ai-sdk/provider 及 20+ 个 provider 包（openai、xai、mistral、groq、google、fireworks、deepseek、cohere、amazon-bedrock、alibaba、moonshotai 等），并披露了对 exhaustive switch/Record 消费者的 TS source-compat 提醒。
@ai-sdk/openai 将 decide 的结构化输出包装器替换为原生 OpenAI Decisions API，仅支持 gpt-6-luna，其它 Responses 模型不再兼容 decisionModel()/evaluationModel()，Responses 选项产生 unsupported-option 警告。
@ai-sdk/google 新增 gemini-nano-banana-2.1 模型 ID，并在检索上下文接地块中保留 file search 自定义元数据；ai@7.0.129 包含稳定代码 deprecation 警告、V2 total token 保留、stream resume 与工具输出暴露等修复。
Batch result 下载 jsonl 限制为 64mb（provider-utils/openai/google/anthropic），并全局升级 TypeScript 6（0af2f7c），许多包仅有依赖更新，属于例行同步。
ai_summary.summary_cn: vercel/ai 本次批量发版 80 个子包虽均为 patch 版本（仓库对 feature 也走 patch 策略），但并非纯版本同步，而是包含广泛的实质变更：核心是跨 20+ provider 新增可移植的 max 推理级别，@ai-sdk/openai 将 decide 切换为原生 OpenAI Decisions API（仅 gpt-6-luna 受支持），@ai-sdk/google 新增新模型 ID，并伴随全局 TypeScript 6 升级与多项修复。无官方标记的 major/breaking，但 openai 的 model 支持收窄与 max 级别的类型拓宽对部分消费者存在兼容性风险，整体综合影响为中等（级别 3）。 本包为值得单独关注的子包：ai@7.0.129

### Patch Changes

- 268225c: feat(provider): add a portable `max` reasoning level with native provider mappings, compatibility coercions, and budget-based fallback support.

  Compatibility notes:

  - **TypeScript source compatibility:** Adding `max` widens `LanguageModelV4CallOptions['reasoning']` and the derived `ReasoningLevel` type. Third-party providers and consumers with exhaustive switches or `Record<ReasoningLevel, ...>` mappings must handle `max` before upgrading. Ordinary calls using existing reasoning levels remain accepted.
  - **Amazon Bedrock:** Existing Nova 2 calls using portable `reasoning: 'xhigh'` now send `maxReasoningEffort: 'high'` instead of the unsupported `'max'`, and return a compatibility warning. Anthropic and OpenAI Bedrock effort mappings retain their existing `xhigh` behavior. Partial Bedrock reasoning configurations continue to preserve explicit values and derive missing fields; explicit effort/budget overrides and disabled thinking no longer emit warnings for portable mappings that are not sent.
  - **Fireworks:** Existing portable `minimal` and `xhigh` calls keep their request mappings to `low` and `high`, respectively, and now return compatibility warnings in generation and streaming results. Portable `max` maps to `high` with the same warning behavior.

  **Release classification:** This remains a patch changeset under the repository's explicit release policy, which uses patch releases for both fixes and features. The TypeScript source-compatibility caveat for exhaustive consumers is disclosed above. Maintainers can override this classification with a `major` label if they decide to align the provider-spec addition with a future AI SDK major release.

### Patch Changes

- 268225c: feat(provider): add a portable `max` reasoning level with native provider mappings, compatibility coercions, and budget-based fallback support.

  Compatibility notes:

  - **TypeScript source compatibility:** Adding `max` widens `LanguageModelV4CallOptions['reasoning']` and the derived `ReasoningLevel` type. releases.summary:
### Patch Changes

- 268225c: feat(provider): add a portable `max` reasoning level with native provider mappings, compatibility coercions, and budget-based fallback support.

  Compatibility notes:

  - **TypeScript source compatibility:** Adding `max` widens `LanguageModelV4CallOptions['reasoning']` and the derived `ReasoningLevel` type. Third-party providers and consumers with exhaustive switches or `Record<ReasoningLevel, ...>` mappings must handle `max` before upgrading. Ordinary calls using existing reasoning levels remain accepted.
  - **Amazon Bedrock:** Existing Nova 2 calls using portable `reasoning: 'xhigh'` now send `maxReasoningEffort: 'high'` instead of the unsupported `'max'`, and return a compatibility warning. Anthropic and OpenAI Bedrock effort mappings retain their existing `xhigh` behavior. Partial Bedrock reasoning configurations continue to preserve explicit values and derive missing fields; explicit effort/budget overrides and disabled thinking no longer emit warnings for portable mappings that are not sent.
  - **Fireworks:** Existing portable `minimal` and `xhigh` calls keep their request mappings to `low` and `high`, respectively, and now return compatibility warnings in generation and streaming results. Portable `max` maps to `high` with the same warning behavior.

  **Release classification:** This remains a patch changeset under the repository's explicit release policy, which uses patch releases for both fixes and features. The TypeScript source-compatibility caveat for exhaustive consumers is disclosed above. Maintainers can override this classification with a `major` label if they decide to align the provider-spec addition with a future AI SDK major release.

releases.summary:
### Patch Changes

- 268225c: feat(provider): add a portable `max` reasoning level with native provider mappings, compatibility coercions, and budget-based fallback support.

  Compatibility notes:

  - **TypeScript source compatibility:** Adding `max` widens `LanguageModelV4CallOptions['reasoning']` and the derived `ReasoningLevel` type. Third-party providers and consumers with exhaustive switches or `Record<ReasoningLevel, ...>` mappings must handle `max` before upgrading. Ordinary calls using existing reasoning levels remain accepted.
  - **Amazon Bedrock:** Existing Nova 2 calls using portable `reasoning: 'xhigh'` now send `maxReasoningEffort: 'high'` instead of the unsupported `'max'`, and return a compatibility warning. Anthropic and OpenAI Bedrock effort mappings retain their existing `xhigh` behavior. Partial Bedrock reasoning configurations continue to preserve explicit values and derive missing fields; explicit effort/budget overrides and disabled thinking no longer emit warnings for portable mappings that are not sent.
  - **Fireworks:** Existing portable `minimal` and `xhigh` calls keep their request mappings to `low` and `high`, respectively, and now return compatibility warnings in generation and streaming results. Portable `max` maps to `high` with the same warning behavior.

  **Release classification:** This remains a patch changeset under the repository's explicit release policy, which uses patch releases for both fixes and features. The TypeScript source-compatibility caveat for exhaustive consumers is disclosed above. Maintainers can override this classification with a `major` label if they decide to align the provider-spec addition with a future AI SDK major release.

### Patch Changes

- 268225c: feat(provider): add a portable `max` reasoning level with native provider mappings, compatibility coercions, and budget-based fallback support.

  Compatibility notes:

  - **TypeScript source compatibility:** Adding `max` widens `LanguageModelV4CallOptions['reasoning']` and the derived `ReasoningLevel` type. Ordinary calls using existing reasoning levels remain accepted.
  - **Amazon Bedrock:** Existing Nova 2 calls using portable `reasoning: 'xhigh'` now send `maxReasoningEffort: 'high'` instead of the unsupported `'max'`, and return a compatibility warning. Anthropic and OpenAI Bedrock effort mappings retain their existing `xhigh` behavior. Partial Bedrock reasoning configurations continue to preserve explicit values and derive missing fields; explicit effort/budget overrides and disabled thinking no longer emit warnings for portable mappings that are not sent.
  - **Fireworks:** Existing portable `minimal` and `xhigh` calls keep their request mappings to `low` and `high`, respectively, and now return compatibility warnings in generation and streaming results. Portable `max` maps to `high` with the same warning behavior.

### Patch Changes

- fc1e19e: fix: limit jsonl rows to 64mb during batch result downloads
- 268225c: feat(provider): add a portable `max` reasoning level with native provider mappings, compatibility coercions, and budget-based fallback support.

  Compatibility notes:

  - **TypeScript source compatibility:** Adding `max` widens `LanguageModelV4CallOptions['reasoning']` and the derived `ReasoningLevel` type. Third-party providers and consumers with exhaustive switches or `Record<ReasoningLevel, ...>` mappings must handle `max` before upgrading. Ordinary calls using existing reasoning levels remain accepted.
  - **Amazon Bedrock:** Existing Nova 2 calls using portable `reasoning: 'xhigh'` now send `maxReasoningEffort: 'high'` instead of the unsupported `'max'`, and return a compatibility warning. Anthropic and OpenAI Bedrock effort mappings retain their existing `xhigh` behavior. Partial Bedrock reasoning configurations continue to preserve explicit values and derive missing fields; explicit effort/budget overrides and disabled thinking no longer emit warnings for portable mappings that are not sent.
  - **Fireworks:** Existing portable `minimal` and `xhigh` calls keep their request mappings to `low` and `high`, respectively, and now return compatibility warnings in generation and streaming results. Portable `max` maps to `high` with the same warning behavior.

  **Release classification:** This remains a patch changeset under the repository's explicit release policy, which uses patch releases for both fixes and features. The TypeScript source-compatibility caveat for exhaustive consumers is disclosed above. Maintainers can override this classification with a `major` label if they decide to align the provider-spec addition with a future AI SDK major release.

### Patch Changes

- 268225c: feat(provider): add a portable `max` reasoning level with native provider mappings, compatibility coercions, and budget-based fallback support.

  Compatibility notes:

  - **TypeScript source compatibility:** Adding `max` widens `LanguageModelV4CallOptions['reasoning']` and the derived `ReasoningLevel` type. Third-party providers and consumers with exhaustive switches or `Record<ReasoningLevel, ...>` mappings must handle `max` before upgrading. Ordinary calls using existing reasoning levels remain accepted.
  - **Amazon Bedrock:** Existing Nova 2 calls using portable `reasoning: 'xhigh'` now send `maxReasoningEffort: 'high'` instead of the unsupported `'max'`, and return a compatibility warning. Anthropic and OpenAI Bedrock effort mappings retain their existing `xhigh` behavior. Partial Bedrock reasoning configurations continue to preserve explicit values and derive missing fields; explicit effort/budget overrides and disabled thinking no longer emit warnings for portable mappings that are not sent.
  - **Fireworks:** Existing portable `minimal` and `xhigh` calls keep their request mappings to `low` and `high`, respectively, and now return compatibility warnings in generation and streaming results. Portable `max` maps to `high` with the same warning behavior.

  **Release classification:** This remains a patch changeset under the repository's explicit release policy, which uses patch releases for both fixes and features. The TypeScript source-compatibility caveat for exhaustive consumers is disclosed above. issue_insights.summary_brief: 今日跨仓库信号高度集中，核心共性问题有三类：一是 AI Agent 工具链在调用后端/API 时普遍因协议不兼容（如 HTTP 400、MCP 初始化/健康检查失败）导致主流程中断；二是会话/上下文状态管理缺陷（压缩后损坏、持久化静默丢失、子进程/后台任务结果丢失）在多仓库造成模型卡死、数据丢失与结果失真；三是权限与安全机制被静默绕过（pre-commit 钩子、域策略、工具批准、凭据外泄），威胁提示注入场景下的数据安全。整体呈现"静默失败"贯穿多仓库的共性趋势，多数缺陷无任何可见报错即令用户数据或结果失真。
global_highlights: 跨仓库 API/协议互操作问题是最大信号簇（203 条、覆盖 42 仓库，P0）：Aperant、Phoenix、goose、agno、anthropic 全系 SDK 均出现 HTTP 400、MCP 初始化失败、Bedrock 提供商兼容性缺陷，导致 AI 生成、规格文档、会话请求等核心主流程普遍被 400/协议拒绝截断。
会话与上下文状态管理是第二高频共性问题（含 compression、compaction、session store、后台任务结果等，35 条、覆盖 15 仓库）：goose 压缩后上下文冻结、agno/opencode SDK 会话持久化静默丢失、anthropic 各语言 SDK 的多轮 replay/compaction 数据损坏，均表现为'静默数据丢失/结果失真'而无报错信号。
安全与权限绕过呈现跨框架共性（pre-commit 绕过、域策略被 service worker/WebSocket 击穿、Write/Edit 绕过宿主权限、工具批准默认过宽、凭据传入子进程），45 条信号覆盖 Agent 框架、SDK 与浏览器自动化工具，集中威胁提示注入下的数据外泄场景。
多仓库存在'静默失败'模式的一致复现（如 OpenHands 错误 toast 暴露原始 JSON、skills 工具缺失静默降级、Phoenix 成本/评估结果静默算错），表明错误处理与可观测性缺失是跨生态的系统性短板，而非个别仓库偶发问题。

top_pain_points.topic: AI 生成流程被后端/API 400 错误中断（规格文档、路线图、外部 MCP 服务器的初始化/健康检查均失败）
top_pain_points.summary: 多个核心 AI 生成工作流因后端 API 返回 HTTP 400 而失败：路线图生成在 Discovery 阶段以 exit code 1 退出、spec 文档写作阶段反复返回未知 400 错误导致 Agent 三次未能创建 spec.md、HTTP 型 MCP 服务器健康检查/连接测试因使用 GET 而非 MCP 初始化 POST 而 400 失败。用户无法完成路线图生成、规格文档生成和外部 MCP 服务器配置。
aliases: HITL 暂停在流式下失败
and/or 对 ndarray 误做真值测试
except 子句不匹配被包裹的内置异常 (#2893 为同缺陷重复报告)
markdown 表格 CRLF 解析
model 退役导致校验调用失败
增强赋值未定义变量静默从 0 开始
复杂类型 NumPy 数组无法远程传输
新模型模型 ID 不被识别
无用的失败 API 请求
矩阵乘法 @ 操作符不支持
远程执行器二次运行即中断
top_pain_points.review_reason: 三条独立 issue 的共同点是后端/API 集成错误(均为 HTTP 400)导致核心生成能力不可用：路线图无法生成、规格文档写作反复失败、外部 MCP 服务器无法配置连接。这些都会阻断或严重降低用户使用 AI 生成功能的主流程，是可见的反复失败。

source_issues.title: Roadmap generation failed with exit code 1
source_issues.evidence: Windows 上点击 Generate Roadmap 后分析在 Discovery Stage 约 40% 进度处失败，报 'Roadmap generation failed with exit code 1'。

source_issues.title: cannot using my own custom API Profiles for antropic compatible provider
source_issues.evidence: 使用自定义 API 配置时 spec 写作阶段连续出现 'API Error: 400 unknown_400_error'，Phase 'spec_writing' failed，Agent 三次未能创建 spec.md。

source_issues.title: HTTP MCP servers return 400 Bad Request during health check (Z.AI and others)
source_issues.evidence: HTTP 型 MCP 服务器(Z.AI 等)健康检查/连接测试返回 400，root cause 是 MCP 健康检查用了 GET 而服务器只支持 POST MCP initialize，导致无法配置和使用这些服务器。

source_issues.title: Agent escapes worktree isolation via cd to parent project path
source_issues.evidence: 任务日志显示 Agent 先正确进入工作树，随后执行 'cd /e/projects/x && git add ...' 与 'git commit'，把提交和文件修改写入主项目，defeating the isolation system；相关 issue 还指出 worktree 远程可能被设到默认分支导致改动写错位置。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Playground can't run OpenAI GPT-6 Sol/Luna/Astra on AWS Bedrock: default temperature=1 is always sent and rejected with 400
source_issues.evidence: 新 AWS playground 实例默认发送 inferenceConfig.temperature:1.0，而 GPT-6 Sol/Luna/Astra 及 gpt-5.6-sol 的任何 temperature 值都被 Converse 以 400 拒绝；温度控件是滑块无法清除，导致这些模型每次运行都失败。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Playground AWS Bedrock fails with ParamValidationError when a prompt replays a tool call (all models)
source_issues.evidence: Bedrock 提供商下，含工具调用的回放 prompt（如 user、AI tool call、tool result 轮次）在请求到达 Bedrock 前就因非法 content block（非 toolUse 格式）触发 ParamValidationError，GPT-6 Sol/Luna/Astra 与 Claude Sonnet 4.6 均失败。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: phoenix-evals AnthropicAdapter structured output fails on Claude Opus 5.5 (Bedrock): forced tool_choice rejected with 400
source_issues.evidence: AnthropicAdapter.generate_object 在 Claude Opus 5.5 / Fable 5.1 上因硬编码强制 tool_choice 被 Bedrock 以 400 拒绝（tool_choice type tool/any 不受支持），结构化输出在这些新模型上完全不可用。

source_issues.title: create_evaluator's tuple-to-Score conversion classifies strings by word count, not position, silently corrupting label/explanation
source_issues.evidence: tuple 分支按词数(<=3 为 label, >=4 为 explanation)而非文档化位置 (score,label,explanation) 归类，两个落同一桶的字符串会静默覆盖；其文档自带的 length_check 示例即产出 label="Length: 42" 而 explanation 未设置，造成静默数据丢失。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Inconsistent mean values for evals
source_issues.evidence: 评估的 mean 值不一致，用户使用 LlamaIndex 埋点在自托管 Phoenix 上观察到评估统计结果不一致。

source_issues.title: ClassificationEvaluator raises a bare StopIteration for an empty choices mapping
source_issues.evidence: 空 choices{} 在构造期抛出消息为空的裸 StopIteration，[] 则被静默接受、直到运行评估时才在 LLM 层暴露；与代码库已有的非空标签校验契约相矛盾，用户得到的是噪音异常而非可用的错误信息。

top_pain_points.topic: Aider 默认以 --no-verify 静默绕过仓库 pre-commit 安全钩子
top_pain_points.summary: Aider 的 git commit 默认不受 --git-commit-verify 保护，自动提交时永远追加 --no-verify，静默绕过 SAST、密钥泄露检测、格式化等本地钩子，用户预置的安全防线在不知情下全部失效。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 用户依赖 pre-commit 钩子作为提交前安全防线，Aider 默认静默绕过使这些防护形同虚设，一旦 LLM 生成含硬编码密钥或注入代码，会无警示地写入 git 历史，直接削弱用户的安全保障能力。

source_issues.title: Security Risk: Aider silently bypasses pre-commit hooks by default (--no-verify)
source_issues.evidence: args.py 默认 default=False 传给 GitRepo，repo.py 中 if not self.git_commit_verify: cmd.append('--no-verify')，导致生成代码（含 API 密钥或恶意代码）直接绕过钩子进入 git 历史且无警告。

source_issues.title: Avoid exposing provider credentials to child commands
source_issues.evidence: run_cmd_subprocess 用 subprocess.Popen 且未提供受限 env，/git 显式 env=dict(subprocess.os.environ)，因此 OPENAI_API_KEY 等凭据对子进程可见，附可复现命令验证。

source_issues.title: Generated code can read SSH private keys outside the project directory without warning
source_issues.evidence: 复现细节：生成代码 os.path.expanduser('~/.ssh/id_rsa') 读取私钥写入 config['SSH_KEY_BACKUP'] 并有 debug 输出，Aider 全程无警告并自动提交。

source_issues.title: Security: developer shell tool executes LLM-supplied commands without sandbox (arbitrary command execution)
source_issues.evidence: 默认启用的非沙箱 shell 工具直接执行 LLM 提供的命令，配合任何被处理的攻击者内容可造成宿主机任意命令执行。

source_issues.title: Security: default GooseMode::Auto approves all tool calls with no policy gate (prompt-injection RCE)
source_issues.evidence: 未设置 GOOSE_MODE 时回退到 Auto，无条件批准所有工具调用，fresh 安装无策略闸门，PoC 证明命令在王环境执行（用户已提交 advisory）。

source_issues.title: Subagents bypass the parent approval mode
source_issues.evidence: Summon 创建的子代理不继承父会话批准模式，子代工具调用绕过父批准策略运行，ACP 客户端用户收不到任何确认请求。

source_issues.title: Prevent sensitive keys and tokens from leaking into history, logs, and LLM context
source_issues.evidence: 敏感值经打磨的六个持久化层（history.txt、终端回滚、SQLite content_json、LLM 上下文、压缩、Langfuse 追踪）全部明文流转，任何观看屏幕或审查历史的人都能看到。

source_issues.title: policy: deny shell * on custom agent breaks free tier with "can only be used from within OpenCode"
source_issues.evidence: 在自定义 primary agent 上 deny shell * 后，所有免费档模型的每次请求都失败，注释掉 deny 行即恢复；Always reproducible

top_pain_points.topic: 会话上下文压缩后损坏导致模型卡在陈旧回复或循环
top_pain_points.summary: 自动压缩/工具对摘要相关的上下文管理缺陷会让模型忽略所有新用户消息、反复重答压缩前状态，或把旧的工具摘要误当成新指令而陷入死循环，且触发消息对用户不可见、UI 也不提示。
aliases: agent 引导改写提交文件
agent 记忆被状态字符串污染
top_pain_points.review_reason: 这三项都直接破坏长会话可用性：模型停止响应新消息、陷入不可见死循环、或上下文读数错误。用户被迫放弃会话，属于反复出现的主流程阻断，且故障对用户不可见难以自行规避。

source_issues.title: Context freeze after compaction: new user messages excluded from requests, model repeats stale responses
source_issues.evidence: 自动压缩（尤其休眠后）后模型忽略所有新消息、反复重答陈旧状态，连续多次，只能关闭重开会话；诊断显示请求逐字节相同。

source_issues.title: Tool pair summarization runs silently, reuses full-compaction threshold, injects agent-only messages
source_issues.evidence: 工具对摘要以 user-role 注入且无历史标记，模型把旧任务关键词当新指令重新执行形成难以诊断的循环，用户看不到触发消息、上下文表显示正常、无任何提示。

source_issues.title: Session context size reads 0 after a request that reports no usage erases it
source_issues.evidence: 无 usage 的响应会把会话总 token 列清为 NULL，CLI/桌面上下文条显示 0/0%，误导用户以为会话为空，直到后续请求上报才恢复。

source_issues.title: Session save is silently dropped when a run contains a non-JSON-serializable value
source_issues.evidence: SqliteDb.upsert_session 用 json.dumps 序列化整行，遇到 Decimal 等非 JSON 值会抛错，随后被 _upsert_session 捕获并在 WARNING 日志后返回 None，调用方无感知。运行正常返回但会话行从未写入或未推进；对于暂停的 HITL 运行意味着暂停静默不可恢复，属于用户数据被静默丢失。

source_issues.title: [Bug] Failed JsonDb session writes destroy the last successfully saved table
source_issues.evidence: JsonDb._write_json_file 在序列化和文件系统写入完成前就以 "w" 模式打开活动表，原生写失败（复现中 EFBIG）会把已保存的 347 字节有效 JSON 表变成 411 字节的部分写入文件，导致之前保存的会话无法再被解析读取，即一次失败的保存破坏了历史数据。

source_issues.title: [Bug] MongoDb session-name and memory search treat user text as a regex
source_issues.evidence: MongoDb/AsyncMongoDb 的 get_sessions(session_name=...) 和 get_user_memories(search_content=...) 把原始用户字符串放进 $regex。含未闭合 ( 或 [ 的值成为无效模式，查询抛错，GET /sessions 与 /memories 返回 HTTP 500；. 匹配任意字符使搜索 v1.2 也会返回 v1x2。用户正常输入即可触发服务器错误或错误结果。

source_issues.title: [BUG] V2: subagent with pending background work (task/shell, background: true) marked completed early — results never collected
source_issues.evidence: 父级收到 state=completed 携带 EARLY_REPLY，工作完成后子的 REAL_FINAL 滞留在子会话永不投递；多个版本 live 复现并附父级 transcript 时间线

source_issues.title: GA content-block replay panics on unknown response variants
source_issues.evidence: ContentBlockUnion.ToParam 对未建模类型无条件在 AsAny() 为 nil 上调用方法,json.Unmarshal 未知块后 ToParam 即 nil-pointer panic。

source_issues.title: Replayed preview starts erase completed managed-agent messages
source_issues.evidence: 已完成 agent.message(id='final', text='complete')被同 ID 的 event_start 替换为空 preview,随后 stale delta 覆盖其内容,span.model_request_end 删除整个消息。

source_issues.title: Compaction deltas can revive cleared values when accumulated messages are replayed
source_issues.evidence: compaction_delta 将 content/encrypted_content 设为 null 后,typed 值变空但 RawJSON/ToParam 仍发送 'previous summary',过期数据被回放。
